walkthrough:
The tangent passes through the contact point and is perpendicular to its radius.
Extract centre $C(1, 2)$ and compute radius and tangent gradients:
$$m_{\text{rad}} = \dfrac{6 - 2}{4 - 1} = \dfrac{4}{3} \implies m_{\text{tan}} = -\dfrac{3}{4}$$

Form the equation of the tangent at $P(4, 6)$:
$$y - 6 = -\dfrac{3}{4}(x - 4)$$
$$4(y - 6) = -3(x - 4) \implies 4y - 24 = -3x + 12 \implies 3x + 4y = 36$$
